# Player mapping coverage

**Tasks:** 08, 09 · Code: `backend/app/mapping/` · Generated by `uv run python -m app.mapping run` (also by the sync) on 2026-10-17 09:10 UTC. Do not edit by hand.

Active = FPL minutes this season > 0.

## Override file

`backend/data/player_overrides.csv` (committed) fixes what auto-matching gets wrong or misses. It is applied on every mapping run (and every sync) and always wins.

```csv
fpl_id,sofascore_id,comment
639,1464641,nickname: Chema Andrés on Sofascore
123,,force no match: wrong person auto-matched
```

- `fpl_id`: FPL element ID (`fpl_players.id`, also the `FPL n` in this report).
- `sofascore_id`: Sofascore player ID (the `Sofascore n` in this report, or the number at the end of the player's sofascore.com URL). The player is mapped to it with `match_method = override`, `is_override = true`. **Empty = force no match**: the player gets no row and is not auto-matched.
- `comment`: free text, why the override exists. Quote it if it contains a comma.
- One row per FPL player and per Sofascore player; a malformed file stops the run before anything is written. Deleting a row hands the player back to auto-matching on the next run.
- A row is skipped (listed below) if its FPL player is unknown, or if its Sofascore player is not in the database yet; the player then stays unmatched until the next sync stores that Sofascore player.
